The '''mission''' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Glova]] occurred when the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces tried to capture the [[Governor/Legends|governor]], [[Tegist Byrg]].

Sometimes after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], New Republic [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Trask Lucan]] arrived on the neutral planet [[Glova]], where he was set up by the planetary governor Tegist Byrg, who had been secretly working for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and who confiscated his ship, the ''[[Lucan's Nightmare]]''. Stranded on the planet, Lucan kept his connections with the New Republic secret and was often found in the local [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] posing as a mere tramp [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] pilot. In [[Borke's Cantina]] he met a group of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] while they were looking for a way to get their ship out of the impound.

Lucan and the smugglers later assisted the [[New Republic soldier/Legends|New Republic troopers]] under the command of New Republic [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] [[Robet Makina]] in a raid on [[Governor's House|Byrg's headquarters]] in order to capture the governor, reveal his connections with the Empire, and reclaim their ships.
